claims.text: Mel Gibson played Max Rockatansky in Mad Max (1979).

Tom Hardy played Max in Mad Max: Fury Road (2015); neither he, Russell Crowe nor Hugh Jackman played Max in the original film.
Mel Gibson was born in New York State and moved with his family to Australia at the age of 12.
